name: Space-Leaping 2 (SL2)
definition: A view-dependent preprocessing strategy that computes the sampling interval for each pixel of the T-Buffer as the position of the first and last samples along the ray that have a relevant value at some frame in the sequence.
summary: Space-Leaping 2 is a view-dependent preprocessing strategy for time-varying volume rendering that computes temporal sampling intervals to skip empty and non-selected voxels, leveraging temporal coherence for efficient rendering.
